name: Karagöl Area to Shkhara - World Record

sourceRecord.description: Guinness World Record photographed terrestrial line of sight from the Karagöl area in Turkey to Shkhara in the Caucasus

details.notes: Current Guinness World Record for the longest photographed terrestrial line of sight. Photographed by Richard Jezik on 15 December 2024 over a distance of 493.07 km (306.37 mi). The observation point was a summit in the Karagöl area at approximately 3,035 m elevation.
details.bestViewingConditions: Exceptional atmospheric clarity and favourable long-distance refraction
